profile.headline: Platform Engineering @ Disney Entertainment & ESPN | Agentic AI & Cloud-Native Infrastructure
profile.summary:
I build AI products and the platforms underneath them. My work sits where applied AI meets production engineering: designing agentic systems that do real work, then making them reliable, observable, and safe enough to put in front of real users. I think in terms of outcomes shipped, not demos, and I bring a platform engineer's discipline to a space that badly needs it.
 
On the AI side, I design and deploy agentic systems and LLM-based tooling end to end, from the problem worth solving, to the agent architecture, to the evaluation and guardrails that decide whether it's actually fit to ship. I treat AI as infrastructure: something to be engineered, monitored, and held to a standard, not bolted on. The product instinct and the reliability instinct are the same instinct for me, which is what keeps these systems useful past the prototype stage.
 
That posture comes out of deep platform work. Most recently I've focused on open source cloud technologies, GitOps and Kubernetes, observability, infrastructure as code, and container-based workloads across major cloud providers, paired with agile delivery and continuous deployment. Before that I spent seven years managing international teams across ERP operations, datacenter operations, virtualization infrastructure, and collaboration services, which taught me how to lead across time zones, keep critical systems running, and turn business objectives into operational reality.
 
Core competencies:
 
Agentic AI systems and LLM-based product development
AI evaluation, guardrails, and safe deployment
Cloud-native architecture and automation
GitOps and Kubernetes
Observability and infrastructure as code
Agile delivery and continuous deployment
Strategic and operational planning
Cross-functional team leadership
Vendor management and regulatory compliance

My Desi Kitchen exists to make the Indian food we love available to everyone in the community. The kind of food that you talk about and keep coming back for.

positions.title: Software Infrastructure and Applications Engineer
positions.description: We partner with our clients to develop a solid business case and plan to achieve results. We then hold ourselves financially accountable to hit the metrics that really matter to you. Fortna has deep expertise in Supply Chain Strategy, Distribution Center Operations, Organizational Excellence, Materials Handling and Supply Chain Systems with a focus on integrating people, processes, systems, and assets.

positions.title: Consultant
positions.description:
Cloud management automation startup that provides a SaaS or on-premise platform for managing IT services and applications. Any organization currently using or planning to use cloud infrastructure (public, private or hybrid) can use this automation solution to improve the time to deliver and modify IT services while reducing the management cost and minimizing risk.

The product makes it easy to design, deploy and operate different type of workloads ranging from simple patterns to custom multi-tier architectures. It delivers more efficient management of cloud resources by using a top-down business focused model as opposed to server-template approach.

positions.title: ERP IT Manager
positions.description:
Managed an international team of Senior Unix Systems Administrators and Database Administrators responsible for the ERP Infrastructure and Operations at Teleflex.  Maintained ERP landscapes for SAP, BI, Content Server, CRM, HCM, Solution Manager and QAD. Ensured regulatory compliance (SOX and FDA) for all systems and processes under the control of ERP operations.

•	Significantly reduced the annual ERP IT Operations budget by leading a 12-month project to redesign the SAP hosting infrastructure with new hardware and virtualization architecture design using IBM PowerVM and EMC SAN storage.

•	Directed the creation of documentation (Functional Design Specification, Work Instructions and Installation Qualifications) that improved accountability and reduced errors for all new installations of ERP instances.

•	Participated in and helped lead a six-month SAP ECC 6 Upgrade project resulting in decreased SAP annual support costs.

positions.title: Web and Collaboration Services Manager
positions.description:
Managed a team engaged in the development and deployment of web applications and content.  Served as a systems analyst for various business units regarding web and collaboration integration projects.
 
•	Implemented an application development architecture and content publishing system that resulted in the creation of the Teleflex Incorporated Intranet.

•	Researched and implemented web-based collaboration software used by IT Operations globally resulting in more effective project communication and document management.

•	Coordinated with various departments to understand functional requirements and translate into technical specifications to support the implementation of web-based business solutions.
 
•	Led project to migrate and virtualize entire web hosting infrastructure using VMware. Reduced costs by consolidating 30 internal and external company web sites into corporate data center.

positions.title: Senior Web/Unix Systems Administrator
positions.description:
Implemented and configured system and performance monitoring, directory services, messaging and calendar services for 8000 users.

•	Designed and deployed a highly available messaging system architecture

positions.title: Senior Unix Systems Administrator
positions.description:
Responsible for the all platforms and infrastructure which hosted half.com. Supported a large installation of Linux/Unix and Windows servers in a 24x7 on-call rotation. 

•	Participated in a project to migrate the half.com infrastructure from Philadelphia to San Jose resulting in reduced datacenter costs.

•	Created a software build and release management system for Half.com which increased efficiencies and reduced bugs while improving software engineers’ productivity.

positions.title: Senior Unix Systems Administrator
positions.description: Team Lead for the technical operations staff responsible for datacenter, network, firewall, enterprise backup, monitoring, software development control system and application servers.

positions.title: Senior Web/Unix Systems Administrator
positions.description: Web infrastructure lead on the project team responsible for implementing the first international Intranet at Frontier Communications.
